column1: # Original DICE Gotcha, play time 172 kOhm (half way: a game lasts about 61.3 s). A
# coin alone (1000 ms) does not start a game; Start (1500 ms) does. Recorded
# closed-loop play: both players close in (2500-25000 ms), stand still (25000-40000
# ms) and close in again (40000-62000 ms) until the timer ends the game. Start
# (66000 ms) begins the second game the coin bought, with cleared counters, and both
# Rows: ms action value (upN/downN/leftN/rightN held switches).
